lines: Audit and optionally resize project images

card.summary: Audit project images for AI-context-safe sizing. Reports unused & oversized; optional resize via macOS sips.
card.paragraph: Scans for images, reports which are unreferenced and which exceed Claude Vision's 1568 px / 500 KB thresholds. Default mode makes no changes.
use_when: Want a defensible report before cleanup
Want to know which assets are unreferenced
dontuse_when: Not on macOS and don't need analysis (raster dims need sips)
Images loaded by constructed strings (false positives in "unused")

extras.title: Thresholds
rows: Claude Vision resizes large images; bytes beyond this are wasted
